source: This is the bridge to later systems topics. Arithmetic intensity in AS03 quantifies work per byte. Roofline in AS04 relates that intensity to hardware ceilings. Shared-memory and register handbooks explain the on-chip staging details that make the reuse possible.
zh: 这是通往后面系统主题的桥梁。 AS03 中的算术强度量化了每个字节的工作量。 AS04 中的 Roofline 将这种强度与硬件天花板联系起来。共享内存和寄存器手册解释了使重用成为可能的片上分级细节。
